Differential expression results: dendritic cells vs monocytes

Código: R/de_celltype_results.R
de_celltype_results.Rd

DESeq2 results comparing in vitro differentiated dendritic cells (moDC or tolDC) against monocytes, within each group (healthy controls and SLE patients). Used in the lesson about monocyte differentiation (vignette("l5_DEGs_monocytes_diff_es"); Figures 4 and 5 of the article).

Uso

de_celltype_results

Formato

A named list with four data frames (Ctrl_moDC, Ctrl_tolDC, SLE_moDC, SLE_tolDC), each with 21,718 rows (genes) and 7 columns: gene, baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue and padj (see de_results).

Fuente

Generated from filtered_txi and metadata_cleaned.

Detalles

Designs (all genes of filtered_txi, reference level monocyte):

  • Controls: ~ Cell_type.

  • SLE patients: ~ SLEDAI_category + Cell_type + Dose_category (adjusted for disease activity and glucocorticoid dose).

Results were extracted with results(alpha = 0.05, name = "Cell_type_<moDC|tolDC>_vs_monocyte") (Wald test, Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment).

With |log2FoldChange| >= 1 and padj < 0.05 (up / down): Ctrl moDC 2688 / 2947, Ctrl tolDC 2731 / 2849, SLE moDC 2945 / 3652 and SLE tolDC 2804 / 3596. The article (DESeq2 on R 4.0.2) reports the same numbers for moDC and differs by a few genes in tolDC (2736 / 2851 and 2804 / 3592). The script that generates this object is data-raw/lesson5_checkpoints.R.

Ver también

de_results (SLE vs Ctrl within each cell type).
